title: ULverify
description: ULVerify is a Minecraft plugin that manages access requests through email verification and a web administration panel, automating whitelisting and notifying players, primarily intended for SMP servers.
body:
ULVerify – Minecraft Server Verification and Management Plugin

Description: ULVerify is a Minecraft server plugin that allows you to manage access requests using an email verification system. It also includes a web-based administration panel to approve, reject, or delete requests and automate the server's whitelist.

Main Features:

Player Request Registration: Players can submit their requests with their Minecraft username, Discord username, email address, and reason for joining. Email Verification System: Sends a verification code to the player's email address before saving their request. Web-Based Administration Panel: Real-time list of requests. Approve, reject, or delete requests directly from the browser. Password protection for administrators. Whitelist Automation: Automatically adds approved players to the server's whitelist. Removes players if their request is deleted. Email Notifications: Sends emails to the player when their request is approved, rejected, or deleted. Flexible Configuration: Configurable via config.yml with server details, SMTP email address, and web panel settings. Ability to use a favicon and customize the web interface. Integrated database: Stores requests in SQLite and maintains a log of pending items in memory.

Configuration:

The homepage image, server name, Discord invite link, email system, and favicon image are configurable within the Config.yml file.

The default password for the admin panel is: NH72540194

Requirements:

Spigot/Paper server, Java 17+, SMTP access (required for sending emails)
